en.name: Elbow bends
en.subtitle: Follow along · Primary 1–3
steps: Face the camera with your hands down and upper arms close to your sides.
Bend both elbows to bring your hands towards your shoulders. Keep your elbows low and your hands visible.
Slowly straighten your elbows and return your hands to your sides.
en.focus: Move both arms together without lifting your shoulders.

zh-Hant.name: 屈伸手肘
zh-Hant.subtitle: 跟著做 · 小一至小三
steps: 面向鏡頭，雙手放下，上臂靠近身旁。
屈曲雙肘，把手靠近肩膀；手肘保持低位，讓鏡頭看到雙手。
慢慢伸直手肘，把雙手放回身旁。
zh-Hant.focus: 雙臂一起移動，肩膀保持放鬆。
